market_query.output: ToolResult: MarketResult data, persisted evidence_refs/result_refs, untouched source/fetch/delay metadata

inputs.snapshot_ref: Exact supplied snapshot_id or returned snapshot:<snapshot_id> reference

portfolio_read.output: ToolResult: complete supplied PortfolioSnapshot data and immutable result_refs; unavailable without supplied snapshot

inputs.formula: put_economics | roll_economics | expiry_payoff | match_coverage | analyze_portfolio | performance
inputs.inputs: Exact Decimal text/integers; formula-specific numeric fields, no extra fields
inputs.parameters: Formula-specific ContractIdentity/price_basis, currency, positions, snapshot_ref or history_refs

finance_calculate.output: ToolResult: dated immutable CalculationRecord data/result_refs with Decimal text, units, currencies, availability and findings

inputs.module_id: Indexed logical module ID from the explicitly selected manifest

knowledge_read.output: ToolResult: hash-validated module metadata and Markdown content frozen when factory is created; unavailable when no bundle/module selected

inputs.record_ref: Exact immutable kind:<logical-id> or idea:<idea-id>@<revision-id> reference

evidence_read.output: ToolResult.data.record: detached typed JSON payload; unavailable for absent valid refs, invalid_data for paths

inputs.kind: evidence | calculation | snapshot | idea | review | quality
inputs.query: Optional exact top-level field matches (maximum 32 fields)

publish_idea.factory: evidence_tools(store); internal compatibility only, not role-exposed

inputs.idea: IdeaRevision; all declared evidence/calculation/snapshot/quality/parent references must resolve in this run; parent/company identities agree

publish_idea.output: ToolResult.data.record_ref and result_refs; immutable revision conflict is invalid_data

publish_review.factory: evidence_tools(store); internal compatibility only, not role-exposed

inputs.review: ExpertReview; reviewed_revision_refs/evidence_refs/calculation_refs must resolve with correct kinds

publish_quality.factory: evidence_tools(store); internal compatibility only, not role-exposed

inputs.assessment: QualityAssessment; evidence_refs must resolve in current run

inputs.query: nonempty public research question, max2000 characters

public_search.output: ToolResult results/evidence_refs with real source URLs, fetched time, source time unknown unless provided; bounded12000 total source text characters; backend unavailable explicit

inputs.urls: 1..5 unique bounded public HTTP(S) URLs; no private/local addresses or embedded credentials

fetch_sources.output: ToolResult results/evidence_refs with immutable source records, explicit per-source failures, truncation/original hashes and publication-time uncertainty; no LLM processing

consult_expert.output: Expert original ordinary assessment with success/partial/failed outcome; automatic owner task, all completed run-local analyst envelopes, separate explorer originals and readable portfolio once

injected_external_doubles: tests/thin/test_tools.py::Provider: synthetic external market capability/result only; actual market closure, schemas and persistence remain real
tests/thin/test_tools.py::InvalidProvider/BrokenProvider: malformed or failed external market responses only
